purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
Requirement record, constraint rule, policy, standard, control, validation shape, test, decision and enforcement remain distinct.
WM-REC-006 parentage remains under review and is only a requirement reference.
Every rule requires explicit kind, normative force, authority, subject, applicability, source and immutable revision.
Closed-world validation, open-world inference, defeasible reasoning and policy combining remain declared profiles.
Syntax validity, satisfaction, verification, validation, conformance, compliance, safety and legal effect remain separate claims.
Exceptions, waivers, conflicts and precedence remain bounded, attributable and independently reviewable.
Every executable projection remains version-pinned, access-controlled and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The entity boundary preserves stable rule identity, source expression, normalized expression, kind and revision lineage.
Authority, subject, applicability, jurisdiction, effective time and exclusions are explicit rather than inferred from prose.
Predicate, operands, datatypes, units, tolerance, cardinality, logic and dependencies form an auditable evaluation contract.
Requirements, policies, standards, controls, systems, tests, evidence, decisions and enforcement remain external records.
Input snapshots, engines, profiles, evaluation traces and outcomes remain independently identified and source-qualified.
Competing rules and evaluations remain visible rather than last-write-wins.
Privileged approval, waiver, enforcement, disclosure and destruction are deny-by-default and authority-bound.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
